# ===================================================================== # SRNF - Price difference without exchange artifact (do not archive) # Shipped by the purchase_stock_price_difference_currency module. # --------------------------------------------------------------------- # Model : Journal Item (account.move.line) # Trigger : On creation # Apply on : [("is_anglo_saxon_line", "=", True), # ("move_id.move_type", "in", ["in_invoice", "in_refund"]), # ("move_id.state", "=", "draft")] # Action : Execute Python code # # How it works: when a vendor bill is posted, Odoo creates the # 569000 / 226050 pair (price difference) right before setting the bill # to "Posted". The action recomputes the difference from the currency # amount of the valuation entry (purchase order price at reception) # instead of the reconversion of the layer at the reception day rate. # If the recomputed difference is zero, the pair is removed; otherwise # its unit price is corrected and Odoo recomputes the amounts. The # native reconciliation then does the rest (ECH entry on 568010). # # The action runs once per created line: we only process the 226050 # correction line, which finds back its twin 569000 line. # =====================================================================
TOL = 0.000001
if record.exists() and record.move_id.state == 'draft': move = record.move_id cur = move.currency_id company_cur = move.company_id.currency_id
# Original invoice line (same product, same label, same quantity) inv_lines = move.invoice_line_ids.filtered( lambda l: l.product_id == record.product_id and l.purchase_line_id and (l.name or '')[:64] == (record.name or '') and float_compare(l.quantity, record.quantity, precision_digits=4) == 0 ) inv_line = inv_lines[:1]
# Only process the correction line (invoice line account = 226050) if (len(inv_lines) == 1 and cur != company_cur and record.account_id == inv_line.account_id and inv_line.product_id.cost_method != 'standard' and not inv_line.tax_ids.filtered(lambda t: t.price_include)):
pdiff = move.line_ids.filtered( lambda l: l.is_anglo_saxon_line and l.id != record.id and l.product_id == record.product_id and l.account_id != record.account_id and float_compare(l.price_unit, -record.price_unit, precision_digits=6) == 0 )[:1]
pol = inv_line.purchase_line_id stock_moves = env['stock.move'].search([ ('purchase_line_id', '=', pol.id), ('state', '=', 'done'), ('product_qty', '!=', 0.0), ]) if move.move_type == 'in_refund': stock_moves = stock_moves.filtered(lambda m: m._is_out()) else: stock_moves = stock_moves.filtered(lambda m: m._is_in())
val_account = inv_line.product_id.product_tmpl_id.get_product_accounts()['stock_valuation'] total_amount = 0.0 total_qty = 0.0 exploitable = bool(stock_moves) and bool(pdiff) for sm in stock_moves: layers = sm.with_context(active_test=False).stock_valuation_layer_ids.filtered( lambda l: l.quantity) amls = layers.mapped('account_move_id.line_ids').filtered( lambda l: l.account_id == val_account) if (not layers or not all(layers.mapped('account_move_id')) or not amls or any(l.currency_id != cur for l in amls)): exploitable = False break total_amount += sum(amls.mapped('amount_currency')) total_qty += sum(layers.mapped('quantity'))
if exploitable and total_qty: valuation_price_unit = inv_line.product_id.uom_id._compute_price( total_amount / total_qty, inv_line.product_uom_id) price_unit = inv_line.price_unit * (1 - (inv_line.discount or 0.0) / 100.0) new_dif = price_unit - valuation_price_unit old_dif = pdiff.price_unit old_cur = pdiff.amount_currency old_cad = pdiff.balance ref_po = pol.order_id.name
# Recomputed difference is zero: drop the native artifact pair if cur.is_zero(new_dif * inv_line.quantity): (pdiff | record).with_context(check_move_validity=False).unlink() msg = ("SRNF - %s - %s : native price difference %.2f %s (%.2f CAD) " "removed; real difference is null (exchange artifact)." % ( ref_po, inv_line.product_id.default_code or '', old_cur, cur.name, old_cad)) move.message_post(body=msg) log(msg) # Recomputed difference is non-zero: correct the unit price elif abs(new_dif - old_dif) > TOL: pdiff.with_context(check_move_validity=False).write({'price_unit': new_dif}) record.with_context(check_move_validity=False).write({'price_unit': -new_dif}) msg = ("SRNF - %s - %s : native price difference %.2f %s (%.2f CAD) " "corrected to %.2f %s (%.2f CAD)." % ( ref_po, inv_line.product_id.default_code or '', old_cur, cur.name, old_cad, pdiff.amount_currency, cur.name, pdiff.balance)) move.message_post(body=msg) log(msg)
